name: Franklin Municipal Green Bond ETF
desc: The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in municipal securities whose interest is free from federal income taxes, including the federal alternative minimum tax. Although the adviser tries to invest all of its assets in tax-free securities, it is possible that up to 20% of the fund's net assets may be invested in securities that pay interest that may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax and in securities that pay interest subject to other federal or state income taxes.
